notes: Bloom: Summer's Glow (a708z5ethq, TERA ACTION, CLERIC): '[Class Bonus] Each opponent sacrifices all Flowerbuds. For each Flowerbud sacrificed, controller summons your choice of a Lycoria or a Baihua token.' cardActivatedAbilities['a708z5ethq:0'] (GeneratedMacroCode.php:16686) returns immediately if !IsClassBonusActive($player, ['CLERIC']) -- the entire printed effect is Class-Bonus-gated, with no baseline behavior otherwise. myField-0 is patched directly to Diao Chan, Enchantress (00xbh8oc00, CLERIC) with Subcards=[Diao Chan, Idyll Corsage (d7l6i5thdy, TERA)] -- this makes myField-0 itself a literal on-field CLERIC champion (IsClassBonusActive scans physical field objects) while granting TERA element access via lineage for legally playing the card; patchMzId never triggers Enter(), so neither champion's own On Enter fires. Two Flowerbud tokens (yn78t73w1p) are seeded onto the opponent's field. The ability queues a TWOSIDEDSLIDER (0..flowerbudCount) plus customDQHandlers['BloomSummerResolve'] (Custom/CardDQHandlers.php); answering '1' sacrifices both Flowerbuds (moved to the opponent's graveyard) and summons exactly 1 Lycoria (89nl1vcn33) + 1 Baihua (i59eamoov0) onto the opponent's field -- a real, non-degenerate split, not an always-one-type stub.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] Each opponent sacrifices all Flowerbuds. For each Flowerbud sacrificed this way, their controller summons your choice of a Lycoria or a Baihua token.
